body: VERIFIED GAP: CookieRecord carries partitionKey and cookieKey() includes it in identity, but background/capture.ts always calls parseSetCookie(line, host) with no third argument, so every captured cookie gets null. Under CHIPS all partitions of one cookie therefore collapse into a single record, which presents to the user as random logouts. The model is already right; only the capture site needs to learn the partition. See docsi/LIMITS.md.
title: CHIPS: capture the cookie partition key
